summary: Iter-20: verified new /admin/orders delivery-type-filter dropdown, sale-mode regression on products/combos, admin auth guards on /admin/offers|/warehouses|/delivery-men, warehouse dropdown on AdminDeliveryMen, and POST /api/orders acceptance of delivery_type='instant'. 8/8 backend tests pass; all 6 UI checks pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3690 lines (pre-existing) — still recommend modularising (unchanged tech debt).
Order-amount validation is strict (server recomputes with shipping); test payloads or client must send the exact final amount. Works as designed but worth documenting.
Public URL cold-start is ~5 min because [catalog_backup] auto-restore runs on every backend boot re-applying 255 delta files. Consider caching restored state to reduce warm-up time (pre-existing).
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted 1 delivery-man ('TEST_DM_...'), created 1 test order via POST /api/orders with delivery_type=instant (order remains — order deletion not in scope). Sale-mode toggled ON then OFF; final state restored to enabled=false.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Verified:
1. /admin/orders → data-testid='delivery-type-filter' exists with options ['all','instant','standard']; each option selectable.
2. PUT /api/admin/sale-mode {enabled:true} → GET /api/products?niche=anti-aging returns items with sale_active=true, sale_badge_label='FLAT 50% OFF', prepaid_price≈round(mrp*0.5), original_prepaid_price populated. Same for /api/combos?niche=anti-aging.
3. Turning sale OFF (with 30s cache bust) removes all data-testid^='sale-badge-' badges on /shop?niche=anti-aging (5 badges → 0 badges verified in browser).
4. POST /api/admin/delivery-men → 401/403 without/with-wrong X-Admin-Token; 200 with correct token.
5. /admin/offers, /admin/warehouses, /admin/delivery-men all redirect to /admin when localStorage admin token cleared.
6. AdminDeliveryMen page renders data-testid='dm-warehouse-input' (add form) and per-row data-testid='dm-warehouse-<id>' selectors.
7. POST /api/orders with delivery_type='instant' persists correctly and appears in /api/admin/orders with delivery_type='instant'.

Gotchas for next agent:
- Backend hot-reload triggers on file writes under /app/backend/tests/; cold-start takes ~5 min due to catalog auto-restore. Warm up with a curl before running tests.
- Product 'sale_active' fields honour a 30s in-process cache (_SALE_CACHE). Sleep 31s after toggling sale-mode before verifying product endpoints.
- Order POST validates the 'amount' server-side (adds shipping etc.); test file handles the 400 mismatch by retrying with server-suggested amount.
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested behaviours confirmed working.
